assumptions.statement: The request records were renamed to CreateResourceSchemaRequest and UpdateResourceSchemaRequest inside their existing files, which keep the old names CreateResourceTypeRequest.cs and UpdateResourceTypeRequest.cs, because the ACL hook blocks every file move or delete (git mv, mv and rm are all denied for be-writer).
assumptions.default_chosen: Rename the records in place and leave the file renames to the conductor or developer.
assumptions.rationale: This keeps the tree compiling and green at every step. The only thing left is the file name, and the content search of quickstart step 3 does not look at file names. The alternative was new files plus emptied old files, which still needs a delete and leaves empty .cs files behind if nobody removes them.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Two file names do not match their record names, which breaks the naming convention. Fix: in backend/src/Modules/Resources/ThingsBooksy.Modules.Resources.Api/Requests run `git mv CreateResourceTypeRequest.cs CreateResourceSchemaRequest.cs` and `git mv UpdateResourceTypeRequest.cs UpdateResourceSchemaRequest.cs`. No code change is needed.
